The situation turns critical because Bapuji needs to hand over a ₹25 lakh donation cheque the next morning for a girls' school in their native village. Jethalal must arrange the money without Bapuji or the Gokuldham residents finding out.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
